verdict: West's sales rose 9% to $875 million and net income jumped 53% to $214 million, lifted by a one-time $56 million gain on selling the SmartDose device business — and demand for high-value components was strong enough for West to raise its full-year guidance.

otherDetail: The printed statement counts a $51M net credit inside operating profit — 'Other expense (income), net' was $51M of income, mostly the $56M gain on selling the SmartDose device business, partly offset by $6M of restructuring charges. This chart shows operating profit before that credit ($217M) and counts the credit in Other income instead; printed operating profit was $268M. Interest expense and interest income roughly offset (~$0M net); the $4M of equity earnings from affiliated companies is counted on its own line in the chart math.
oneTimers: A $55.7M pre-tax gain on the sale of the SmartDose 3.5mL On-Body Delivery System to AbbVie sits in other operating income (a $54.0M net benefit after related M&A costs, with about $22M of one-time tax on the gain) — it is the main reason GAAP EPS of $3.02 is above adjusted EPS of $2.66.
Restructuring and other charges were $6.3M pre-tax in the quarter under West's restructuring and legal-structure programs.

takeaways.title: High-value components led
takeaways.text: High-Value Product Components sales rose 20% to $467M — 53% of all sales — as drug makers bought more premium stoppers, seals and plungers for injectable medicines.

takeaways.title: Margins jumped
takeaways.text: Operating margin before the one-off SmartDose credit was 24.8%, up from a year ago on a richer product mix — high-value components are simply more profitable. As printed, including the gain, the margin was 30.6%; excluding one-offs, adjusted operating margin also improved year over year.

takeaways.title: Guidance raised
takeaways.text: Full-year 2026 guidance went up: net sales of $3.41–3.42B and adjusted-diluted EPS of $9.38 to $9.48, up from $8.85 to $9.05 previously.

footerNote: West prints figures to one decimal: net sales were $874.5M, gross profit $347.4M and operating profit $267.4M; this chart rounds to whole $M. The printed 'Other expense (income), net' line was $51.2M of income (mostly the SmartDose gain); following this site's usual treatment of one-off gains, the chart shows it in Other income below operating profit rather than as a negative expense, so chart operating profit is $217M vs $268M as printed. Segments are the printed Proprietary Products and West Vantage (contract manufacturing and services).
